headline: Nigerian Stock Exchange Market Capitalization Falls N514 Billion in Heavy Sell-Off
summary: Bearish sentiment dominated the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX) as selling pressure across heavyweight stocks erased N514.91 billion in equity market capitalization during a single session, despite a rally in insurance shares.
why: The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) is West Africa's leading stock exchange by equity market value.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: Nigerian equity market capitalization fell N514.9 billion in a single session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heavy selling pressure across major sectoral index heavyweights dragged Nigerian equities lower.
